ticks.note: The environment ticks the chart every 500 ms, and the hardware timer makes `second` true in every other tick (ticks 2, 4, 6, ...): one pulse per second.
A pulse, but nobody is waiting yet.
`start`: `Idle` → `Waiting`. This happens just before a pulse: the next one comes in the very next tick.
The first counted pulse, only 500 ms after the start.
The second pulse: `if 2 second` fires and `done` is true, 1.5 s after the start.
`start` again, this time in a tick that has a pulse. A delayed transition does not count the tick its state was entered in, so this pulse does not count.
Second pulse: `done`, now 2 s after the start. The same chart waited 1.5 s once and 2 s once.
